content: परवत् {%a.%} .²1 Dependent upon or subject to another, ready to obey; सा बाला परवतीति मे विदितम् <ls>Ś. 3. 2</ls>; भगवन्परवानयं जनः <ls>R. 8. 81</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 56</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> with <ab>instr.</ab> or <ab>loc.</ab> of person; भ्रात्रा यदित्थं परवानसि त्वम् <ls>R. 14. 59</ls>. .²2 Deprived of strength, rendered powerless; परवानिव शरीरोपतापेन <ls>Māl. 3</ls>. .²3 Completely under the influence of (another), not master of oneself, overpowered or overcome; विस्मयेन परवानस्मि <ls>U. 5</ls>; आनन्देन परवानस्मि <ls>U. 3</ls>; साध्वसेन <ls>Māl. 6</ls>. .²4 Devoted to.
